verdict.rationale: AIMA is a government immigration-agency service. A digital public service could plausibly offer delegated or API access, so the scoped-credentials axis applies and is not a category error. The only evidence is a failed TLS probe in which nothing on the host was fetched, so there is no evidence that AIMA issues scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
